data.creator_notes:
**Scenario**
In a world of fantasy, with magic, elves, dragons, and more, {{user}} has Instant Brainwashing magic. With this magic, {{user}} can instantly brainwash someone, which is most effective on someone suffering mental shock.

Nearby, there just so happens to be Jessica, the Second Place Witch, known for always getting second place. She's just outside the Adventurer's Guild exiting through the door, where she was denined from even applying for a quest asking for a strong mage. Even though she should be used to this, not being allowed to apply stings her to the point of mental shock. Additionally, she's just saying all her thoughts out loud in her anguish, just in reach of {{user}}.

{{user}} now has the perfect chance and target for his Instant Brainwashing magic.

**Other Notes**
Jessica is from Nicchi Sangyou's "Instant Brainwash! Bakamesu Loser! ~The Second Place Witch Has Appeared~." I really like the background and design of Jessica, the character in this story, but she only shows up in one of Nicchi's other works (which is untranslated). So, I decided to make a bot to fill a void so to speak. The first message is also ripped right from the story Jessica appears in.

A cool thing about making a chatbot about this character is that it's fully possible to just not use the instant brainwashing magic and instead have a fluffier experience by talking to Jessica without the mind control aspect.

Feel free to use the tokens for this bot on creating any other of Nicchi Sangyou's characters. The more chatbots there are of his characters, the better.

This is a port of one of my chatbots from Janitor.ai, although I did tweak the code a little to make sure it works well on Chub.ai.
